bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears released their Week 2 injury report ahead of Sunday's matchup against the Vikings, with everyone available to play including tackle Darnell Wright, who had missed practice time earlier in the week. The Chicago Bears have released their final injury report for Week 2, and it is good news with everyone being available to play, including Darnell Wright.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions suffered a rough Week 2 loss on Thursday night, falling 41-31 to the Buffalo Bills at the new Highmark Stadium, with the Lions' defense in rough shape, allowing 31 points and never having a chance against the Bills . packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers are dealing with injury concerns ahead of their Week 2 matchup against the New York Jets, as the team may have to prepare for their Week 2 matchup with the New York Jets without two members of their defense, with both players currently dealing with concussion symptoms that could keep them out of the game . Additionally, the team released its list of injury updates ahead of the Jets game, with several players missing practice on Friday , as Green Bay looks to bounce back from an 0-1 start to the season.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Kyler Murray was officially ruled out for Sunday's Week 2 matchup against the Chicago Bears after failing to clear the concussion protocol, meaning Carson Wentz will make his first start of the season while J.J. McCarthy moves up to serve as backup quarterback.
